items.known: CKV_AWS_17 Ensure all data stored in RDS is not publicly accessible (resource aws_db_instance.default)
items.remediation: Set publicly_accessible = false so the RDS instance is only reachable from within the VPC.

items.known: CKV_AWS_16 Ensure all data stored in the RDS is securely encrypted at rest (resource aws_db_instance.default)
items.remediation: Set storage_encrypted = true and specify a kms_key_id pointing to a customer-managed KMS key for full control over key rotation and access.

items.known: CKV_AWS_293 Ensure that AWS database instances have deletion protection enabled (resource aws_db_instance.default)
items.remediation: Add deletion_protection = true to the aws_db_instance resource block.

items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group_rule.egress)
items.issue: Unrestricted outbound access from RDS security group
items.remediation: Restrict the egress rule to only the protocols and destinations the database legitimately needs, or remove the egress rule entirely if no outbound connectivity is required.

items.known: CKV_AWS_355 Ensure no IAM policies documents allow "*" as a statement's resource for restrictable actions (resource aws_iam_role_policy.ec2policy)
items.issue: Overly broad IAM permissions (wildcard actions and resources)
items.remediation: Replace the wildcard actions with only the specific actions the application requires (e.g. s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject) and replace Resource: * with the specific ARNs of the S3 bucket, EC2 resources, and RDS instance that the application needs to access.

items.known: CKV_AWS_79 Ensure Instance Metadata Service Version 1 is not enabled (resource aws_instance.db_app)
items.issue: IMDSv2 not enforced on EC2 instance
items.remediation: Add a metadata_options block to the aws_instance resource with http_tokens = "required" and http_endpoint = "enabled" to enforce IMDSv2 for all metadata requests.

items.known: CKV_AWS_8 Ensure all data stored in the Launch configuration or instance Elastic Blocks Store is securely encrypted (resource aws_instance.db_app)
items.issue: No EBS volume encryption on EC2 instance
items.remediation: Add a root_block_device block with encrypted = true and kms_key_id set to a customer-managed KMS key ARN, or enable default EBS encryption at the account level.

scores.reason: Correctly identifies aws_db_instance.publicly_accessible and sets it to false.
Correct fix: set aws_db_instance.storage_encrypted = true; adding kms_key_id is specific and valid.
Correctly adds deletion_protection = true on aws_db_instance.
Correct direction for aws_security_group_rule.egress: remove unrestricted 0.0.0.0/0 egress or constrain protocol/destination.
Right principle, but vague for this check; does not name exact policy statements/resources to change in aws_iam_role_policy.
Correctly specifies metadata_options with http_tokens = "required" on aws_instance; http_endpoint enabled is fine.
Correct fix for EC2 EBS encryption: add root_block_device.encrypted = true; kms_key_id is a valid specific enhancement.
